thread:
Maya: quick thread 11 need a tight bench narrative for the launch post + webinar. one hero visual + micro calculator.
Jonah: agree. hero = scatter (p95 latency ms on x, $ per 100k tokens on y). annotate the "knee" where low-latency costs explode. small CDF inset for tail behavior.
Priya: can mock that. pls confirm workload mix (chat vs gen) and which model variants to show.
Maya: use 70% chat (avg 256 tokens) + 30% generation (avg 1024). show three rows: baseline (standard infra), accel GPU + batching, Redwood (cache + quant + routing).
Carlos: I'll export a tiny CSV: header = model_variant, seq_type, seq_len, p50_ms, p95_ms, cost_per_100k, throughput_qps. dropping in /shared/perf/1746512345.csv by lunchtime.
Priya: perfect. visual plan: hero scatter, point color = variant, size = throughput, label 2 callouts: "Redwood: cost-efficiency zone" and "knee: latency premium". CDF inset: % requests <= 200ms, 500ms.
Elena: style: single-image hero for blog, muted greys + teal accent for Redwood. export: hero PNG (1200x675) + slide PNG (1920x1080). No long text on image.
Rohit: messaging hooks: 1) predictable p95 reduces ops surprises; 2) lower unit token cost frees iter velocity; 3) one API for hosted/dedicated/private. keep each <= 10 words.
Sam: inbound: add two hidden signup fields on webinar form: "monthly_tokens_estimate" and "primary_constraint" (latency/cost/controls). routing: latency-> AE_Platform, cost-> SDR_Growth, controls-> SolutionsEng. I can map to CRM tags.
Jonah: webinar format: 25m demo (infra & live bench), 10m charts walk, 15m Q&A. owners: Maya host, Carlos demo infra, Priya charts, Jonah bench narrative, Sam lead follow-ups.
Maya: CTA on post: "Try our quick token-cost calculator" -> leads to mini form + estimate + recommended deployment. Priya can make a mock table for the landing.
Priya: I'll wire a table: inputs = avg_tokens, requests/day, %cached_prefix. outputs = monthly_token_count, est_cost_hosted, est_cost_dedicated, suggested_deployment. mock values until Carlos CSV.
Carlos: CSV uploaded: /shared/perf/1746512345.csv (link). includes realistic p95 and cost columns.
Priya: grabbed it. prototyping scatter now. will add annotation for the knee and a tiny legend explaining caching/batching/quant.
Elena: once mock assets ready drop in Figma page "bench-hero-v2". keep alt text short for social.
Maya: copy bullets (hero): "Predictable p95, less surprise ops", "Lower unit token cost with caching + batching", "Same API across hosting options". feedback?
Rohit: fine but change "less surprise ops" -> "fewer SLA surprises". more precise.
Maya: done. final hero copy will avoid % claims. add a slide footnote: "bench demo shows up to XX% cost savings; see blog for numbers".
Sam: I'll update the signup and CRM rules tonight. also add a conversion event for the calc.
Jonah: deck note: include 1-sentence slide that explains "knee": why ultra-low latency forces expensive config. helps sales qualify.
Priya: mock assets done -> /assets/bench/1746512345-mock-scatter.png and /assets/bench/1746512345-mock-cdf.png.
Carlos: demo infra note: we'll run a 95/256/1024 mix and keep a fallback hosted endpoint. provisioning now.
Elena: prepping hero + slide templates. need final copy strings from Maya/Jonah by 3pm.
Maya: timeline: charts & mock assets by EOD today, final numbers by tomorrow AM, publish schedule T+4 days.
Jonah: will draft the 3-slide bench walkthrough for dev preview.
Maya: owners recap: Carlos (perf CSV + demo infra), Priya (charts + calc mock), Elena (visuals), Jonah (narrative + slides), Sam (signup + routing), Rohit (messaging polish), Maya (publish approvals).
Maya: thanks all. post here when you push assets. :rocket:
